title: `title`
description: A human friendly display name for the tool. Presentational, not a safety signal.
question: Is the tool title annotation present at each capture boundary?
notes: The title is absent from all five declared capture definitions. LangChain, Pydantic AI, and OpenAI Agents SDK retain it elsewhere on their adapted tool objects; CrewAI and Mastra drop it. No v0.1 renderer captures a serialized provider request.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI: the adapted tool object exposes no annotations field, so the value is not recoverable after adaptation.
notes_by_num.2: LangChain: retained on `StructuredTool.metadata`, but absent from the OpenAI-compatible dictionary produced by `convert_to_openai_tool`.
notes_by_num.3: OpenAI Agents SDK: `FunctionTool` keeps `_mcp_title` only. The behavioural hints are not carried.
notes_by_num.4: Pydantic AI: retained in `ToolDefinition.metadata['annotations']`. Not part of `parameters_json_schema`.
notes_by_num.5: Mastra: `mcpMetadata` carries the server name and version only. Annotations are not attached to the tool.

verdict.headline: Retained elsewhere by three frameworks, dropped by two.
verdict.detail: The title is absent from every captured tool definition. Final provider requests were not captured.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: Low stakes. Included for completeness rather than concern.
